clips.title: The story
paras: On Fenris Isle, Resting in Pieces begins with Alaric's animated, severed head. He asks to be carried across Fenris Keep to an unmarked grave near the stables, where the rest of his remains lie.

Alaric once served as Thule Ravenclaw's chief servant and personal bodyguard at Fenris Keep in Silverpine Forest. Thule was a powerful mage aligned with the Scourge. When the Plague of Undeath swept through the region, he promised his sorcery would shield Alaric from it. Instead, the ward trapped Alaric in endless agony and undeath, with his awareness intact in his severed parts.

Thule created the rot hide gnolls by infecting local packs with necromantic decay, then turned against his own bodyguard. He cut off Alaric's head and threw it to the savage gnolls as a diversion. The rot hides dragged Alaric's body to a shallow, hastily dug grave outside the keep's stables. They kept his speaking head as a grim plaything until an outsider intervened.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You don't look like a rot hide. Good. I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard. He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape. And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... And gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!
Please, take me to my body. I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body. It is good to know they did not.
